title: Estimators of different delta coefficients based on the unbiased estimator of the expected proportions of agreements
summary: To measure the degree of agreement between two observers that independently classify $n$ subjects within $K$ categories, it is common to use different kappa type coefficients, the most common of which is the $κ_C$ coefficient (Cohen's kappa). As $κ_C$ has some weaknesses -such as its poor performance with highly unbalanced marginal distributions-, the $Δ$ coefficient is sometimes used, based on the $delta$ response model.
